GEO_IMAGER.description: Imaging radiometer on a geostationary platform.

LEO_IMAGER.description: Imaging radiometer on a low-Earth-orbiting platform.

REANALYSIS.description: Retrospective analysis of a fixed model and assimilation system.

CLOUD_OPTICAL_DEPTH.description: Dimensionless vertical optical depth of the cloud column.

CLOUD_TOP_HEIGHT.description: Height of the cloud top above a stated reference.

CLOUD_TOP_PRESSURE.description: Atmospheric pressure at the cloud top.

CLOUD_TOP_TEMPERATURE.description: Brightness or thermodynamic temperature at the cloud top.

CLOUD_MASK.description: Categorical cloudy / clear classification. Category meanings are stated in CATEGORY_LABELS; an unlabelled mask is uninterpretable.

CLOUD_FRACTION.description: Fraction of the cell covered by cloud.

CLOUD_LIQUID_MIXING_RATIO.description: Mass mixing ratio of cloud liquid water.

CLOUD_ICE_MIXING_RATIO.description: Mass mixing ratio of cloud ice.

RAW.description: No compression; transmitted bytes are the packed array.

GEOSTATIONARY.description: Perspective view from a fixed sub-satellite longitude, addressed in scan angles. Requires SUB_SATELLITE_LON_DEG and PERSPECTIVE_HEIGHT_M.

FIRST_ROW_NORTH.description: Row 0 is the northernmost (or largest-Y) row.

FIRST_ROW_SOUTH.description: Row 0 is the southernmost (or smallest-Y) row.

AGFProjectionParameters.description:
Explicit georeferencing parameters. Which members are meaningful is fixed
by AGF.PROJECTION. Members that do not apply to the stated projection are
written NaN, never 0 — a zero standard parallel is a real parallel.

THIS TABLE IS AUTHORITATIVE. PROJ4_STRING and WKT2_STRING never override it.

SEMI_MAJOR_AXIS_M.description: Semi-major axis of the reference ellipsoid, metres.

SEMI_MINOR_AXIS_M.description:
Semi-minor axis of the reference ellipsoid, metres. Equal to the
semi-major axis for a spherical Earth.

INVERSE_FLATTENING.description:
Inverse flattening, when the figure is stated that way. NaN if the
semi-axes are the stated form.

DX.description:
Cell spacing along the X and Y axes, in the units named by
GRID_SPACING_UNITS.

GRID_SPACING_UNITS.description:
UDUNITS units of DX, DY, X_ORIGIN and Y_ORIGIN. Metres for the projected
forms; radians for GEOSTATIONARY scan angles; degrees for
LATLON_REGULAR.

X_ORIGIN.description:
Projection coordinate of the CENTRE of cell (0, 0), in
GRID_SPACING_UNITS. The centre, not a corner: a half-cell offset is the
classic silent georeferencing error.

CENTRAL_MERIDIAN_DEG.description: Longitude of the projection origin or central meridian, degrees east.

ORIGIN_LATITUDE_DEG.description: Latitude of the projection origin, degrees north.

STANDARD_PARALLEL_1_DEG.description: Latitude at which the projection is true to scale.

SCALE_FACTOR_AT_ORIGIN.description: Scale factor at the origin or central meridian.

FALSE_EASTING_M.description: False easting and northing applied to projected coordinates, metres.

SUB_SATELLITE_LON_DEG.description: Longitude of the sub-satellite point, degrees east.

PERSPECTIVE_HEIGHT_M.description: Height of the perspective point above the ellipsoid, metres.

SWEEP_ANGLE_AXIS_IS_X.description:
True when the scan angles are swept along the Earth's sweep axis rather
than the instrument's. The two conventions differ by a rotation and
mis-georeference the whole disc.

PROJ4_STRING.description:
Convenience rendering of this projection. ADVISORY, NEVER AUTHORITATIVE:
where it disagrees with the explicit parameters above, the explicit
parameters win.

WKT2_STRING.description: Convenience WKT2 rendering. ADVISORY, NEVER AUTHORITATIVE, same rule.

AGFProvenance.description:
Where this field came from and how it was produced. Provenance is DATA:
specific instruments, products and producers are named here as strings, not
in an enumeration.

SOURCE_CLASS.description: What kind of system produced the field.

GEO_IMAGER.description: Imaging radiometer on a geostationary platform.

LEO_IMAGER.description: Imaging radiometer on a low-Earth-orbiting platform.

REANALYSIS.description: Retrospective analysis of a fixed model and assimilation system.

SOURCE_ID.description:
Identity of the specific platform, instrument or model instance, as its
operator states it. Required: an unattributed field is not publishable.

PRODUCT_ID.description: Identity of the specific product or algorithm output within SOURCE_ID.

PRODUCER.description: Organisation that produced and published the field.

SOURCE_URI.description: Replayable location the field was retrieved from.

ALGORITHM_VERSION.description: Version of the retrieval or model configuration.

LICENSE.description:
Licence terms. Empty means UNKNOWN TERMS — never public domain, never a
grant to redistribute.

ID.description: Stable identifier of this field record.

EPOCH.description:
Nominal time the field represents, ISO 8601 UTC. For an observation this
is the observation time; for a forecast it is the validity time.

VALID_START.description:
Half-open validity window [VALID_START, VALID_END), ISO 8601 UTC. A
field is a sample of a continuous atmosphere and is not valid forever.

FORECAST_REFERENCE_TIME.description:
Model initialisation time, ISO 8601 UTC. ABSENT for an observation — an
observation has no forecast reference time, and an empty string here is
what distinguishes the two cases.

FORECAST_LEAD_S.description:
Seconds from FORECAST_REFERENCE_TIME to EPOCH. Meaningful ONLY when
FORECAST_REFERENCE_TIME is present; NaN otherwise. It is never inferred
to be zero for an observation.

VARIABLE.description: The physical quantity. It does NOT imply units.

CLOUD_OPTICAL_DEPTH.description: Dimensionless vertical optical depth of the cloud column.

CLOUD_TOP_HEIGHT.description: Height of the cloud top above a stated reference.

CLOUD_TOP_PRESSURE.description: Atmospheric pressure at the cloud top.

CLOUD_TOP_TEMPERATURE.description: Brightness or thermodynamic temperature at the cloud top.

CLOUD_MASK.description: Categorical cloudy / clear classification. Category meanings are stated in CATEGORY_LABELS; an unlabelled mask is uninterpretable.

CLOUD_FRACTION.description: Fraction of the cell covered by cloud.

CLOUD_LIQUID_MIXING_RATIO.description: Mass mixing ratio of cloud liquid water.

CLOUD_ICE_MIXING_RATIO.description: Mass mixing ratio of cloud ice.

UNITS.description:
UDUNITS-compatible units of the SCALED physical value. Required: the
enum names a quantity, this names its scale, and a field without it is
uninterpretable.

CATEGORY_LABELS.description:
Category meanings for a categorical VARIABLE such as CLOUD_MASK, indexed
by raw value. Empty for continuous variables.

DTYPE.description: Element type of the packed array.

FILL_VALUE.description: Sentinel marking a cell with no data, in RAW units, before scaling.

SCALE_FACTOR.description:
physical = raw * SCALE_FACTOR + ADD_OFFSET, applied only to non-fill
cells. Defaults are the identity packing.

NX.description: Number of columns and rows. The payload holds exactly NX * NY elements.

ROW_ORDER.description: Order of the NY rows within the payload.

FIRST_ROW_NORTH.description: Row 0 is the northernmost (or largest-Y) row.

FIRST_ROW_SOUTH.description: Row 0 is the southernmost (or smallest-Y) row.

GEOSTATIONARY.description: Perspective view from a fixed sub-satellite longitude, addressed in scan angles. Requires SUB_SATELLITE_LON_DEG and PERSPECTIVE_HEIGHT_M.

PAYLOAD_CODEC.description: Codec applied to the packed array.

RAW.description: No compression; transmitted bytes are the packed array.

PAYLOAD.description:
Inline post-codec bytes. LEGAL ONLY when PAYLOAD_SIZE_BYTES is at most
1048576. MUST be absent when PAYLOAD_CID is present.

PAYLOAD_CID.description:
Content-addressed reference to the identical post-codec byte string.
MUST be absent when PAYLOAD is present, and MUST be used when the
post-codec size exceeds 1048576 bytes.

PAYLOAD_SHA256.description:
Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the post-codec byte string. REQUIRED in BOTH
payload modes — it is what proves an inline and a fetched payload are
the same object.

PAYLOAD_SIZE_BYTES.description:
Length of the post-codec byte string, bytes. REQUIRED in BOTH payload
modes; it is what makes the 1 MiB inline rule checkable without
decoding. Zero is never valid for a populated field.

PROVENANCE.description: Where the field came from. Required.

DESCRIPTION.description: Free-text description of the field, not of its vendor.
